cases.name: Every selectable target is backed by a single-input planned route; priorities ascend
File names reject paths, blocked extensions, missing suffixes and source mismatch
Unsupported route is rejected before creating a task
Degradation routes require approval in the store as well as the page
FIFO queue permits one running task and a single timer
Five stages are monotonic and completion is explicitly demo-only
Pause freezes progress; resume excludes paused wall time
Cancellation near completion cannot later become completed
History cleanup retains running and paused tasks
Observers receive independent snapshots and unsubscribe cleanly
History is bounded; new tasks evict finished records only
Native load failure stays unavailable and can be retried
Native requests block traversal/budget errors and empty or mismatched successful output
Capability detection times out if preview platform does not settle its promise
All five pages are registered and task views invalidate on status/progress changes
